changelog: Added a theme-aware Help Center with searchable topics, article outlines, back navigation, and offline access.
Improved Help, Settings, and ROE controls across themes, including Standard navigation highlights.
Fixed Bulk Transfer duplicate-warning handling and kept each record's result independent.
Improved Static Group additions to wait for each save, recognize existing members beyond the first 100, and preserve partial progress.
Static Group history refresh now updates names as well as member counts.
Restart App now fully relaunches the app to load current changes.
Restored the required runtime files in the Apple Silicon package.
